title: ISdetector: precise mapping of insertion sequences and associated structural variations from short-read sequencing data
authors: Zhou, Y., Lu, B., Zhao, Y.
abstract: Motivation. Repetitive insertion sequences (ISs) and adjacent structural variants (SVs) complicate precise mapping from bacte-rial short reads. Accurate insertion coordinates are important for studying genome evolution and tracking transmission. Results. ISdetector constructs IS-specific references with target copies removed and clusters soft-clipped reads to pinpoint insertion sites.
